content.description: We have created poolinfo.me for Cardano delegators and pool operators, a website dedicated to assisting delegators in monitoring the pool they have staked with. Through this platform, delegators can easily check the status of pool relays, verify meta hash matches, and access other relevant information like pledge and staking amount. Interested in a hands-on experience with poolinfo.me? We invite you to explore our platform and see how easy it is to monitor your staked pool. We have created poolinfo.
